abstract: Heterogeneity of placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP-like enzyme) in seminoma was studied. PLAP-like enzyme from seminoma tissues was separated into three areas with different proportions between tumors, while PLAP and PLAP-like enzymes in normal testes were separated into two areas on the basis of hydrophobicity. By use of lectin affinity chromatography, PLAP-like enzyme in seminoma revealed extra sugar chains compared to PLAP, indicating heterogeneity of the carbohydrate moiety. However, the glycosylation patterns were found to be essentially similar between seminoma and normal testis. On isoelectric focusing, differences in migration patterns of PLAP-like enzyme were revealed between seminoma and normal testis as well as between PLAP-like enzyme and PLAP. The differences in charge were mainly due to differences in sialylation of the molecules. The complex pattern on isoelectric focusing was not altered by neuraminidase treatment, indicating a considerable charge heterogeneity within the population of PLAP-like enzyme molecules from seminoma.
abstract_ja: セミノーマ組織のPLAP様酵素の不均一性を検討した。PLAP様酵素は、腫瘍ごとに割合の異なる3つの領域に分離されたが、正常精巣のPLAPおよびPLAP様酵素は疎水性に基づき2つの領域に分離された。レクチン親和性クロマトグラフィーにより、セミノーマのPLAP様酵素はPLAPと比べて余分な糖鎖を有することが示され、糖鎖部分の不均一性が示唆された。しかし、糖鎖のパターンはセミノーマと正常精巣でほぼ同様であった。等電点電気泳動では、セミノーマと正常精巣の間、またPLAP様酵素とPLAPの間で、PLAP様酵素の泳動パターンに違いが認められた。電荷の違いは主に分子のシアル酸化の差によるものであった。ノイラミニダーゼ処理によっても等電点電気泳動の複雑なパターンは変化せず、セミノーマ 由来のPLAP様酵素分子集団には、かなりの電荷の不均一性があることが示された。
